digest.component_or_area: session provenance and ticket claim tracking
propositions: When a second agent session operates on a ticket held in_progress by a first session, no warning is currently surfaced to either session, enabling unknowing parallel work collisions.
The claim-session provenance fields are not cleared when a ticket transitions out of in_progress, leaving stale holder information on completed or reopened tickets.
A non-blocking, session-aware warning detector is needed that fires only for single-ticket-targeted operations when the acting session differs from the live claimed_session holder.
The warning signal must be surfaced consistently across CLI (stderr), MCP (response field), and library (warnings.warn) surfaces, but must remain silent on bulk read operations.
The feature is gated by a config toggle (warnings.cross_session, default on) and remains silent when acting session id is unresolved.
